title: Update plexus tactus dependency to use bare tactus for core, tactus[rca] in ml extra

comments.author: derek
comments.text: Starting work: verifying Tactus 0.51.3 packaging metadata and extras on PyPI, then updating pyproject.toml pin if compatible.

comments.author: derek
comments.text: Completed verification and bump: PyPI metadata for tactus 0.51.3 still provides base package plus extras (dev, discord, email, hf, ml, notifications, rca, slack). Updated pyproject.toml pin from ^0.51.2 to ^0.51.3 and regenerated poetry.lock (tactus now 0.51.3).

comments.author: derek
comments.text: Dependency audit complete for tactus extras against current Plexus imports. Findings: rca is required (multiple runtime imports of biblicus.analysis.reinforcement_memory in Evaluation and report blocks). No direct repo usage found for tactus extras email/slack/discord/notifications/dev. hf/ml tactus extras were also not required because Plexus already declares needed ML/HF deps directly. Implemented pin as dual-constraint: base tactus ^0.51.3 always, tactus[rca] only when project extras ml/all are selected. Regenerated poetry.lock and validated with poetry check.
